user.title: Grocery App
user.description: Connect a grocery list. Credentials are stored in this config entry and sent only as request headers.

data_description.url: Origin of the grocery app, such as https://example.com. Do not include a username, password, or query string. The integration appends /api/ha to this URL.
data_description.access_client_id: Cloudflare Access service token client ID. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Id header.
data_description.access_client_secret: Cloudflare Access service token client secret. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Secret header.
data_description.app_token: Grocery app API token. Sent as an Authorization Bearer header, never in the URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh Grocery App credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The grocery app rejected the saved credentials. Enter the Access service token and the app API token again. The base URL is left unchanged.

data_description.access_client_id: Cloudflare Access service token client ID. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Id header.
data_description.access_client_secret: Cloudflare Access service token client secret. Sent as the CF-Access-Client-Secret header.
data_description.app_token: Grocery app API token. Sent as an Authorization Bearer header, never in the URL.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Grocery App
reconfigure.description: Update the grocery app base URL and credentials. Credentials are sent only as request headers.
